summary.text: Phil Plummer is the Republican candidate for Ohio State Senate District 5 and currently represents District 39 in the Ohio House of Representatives, where he has served since 2019.
A former Montgomery County sheriff, he has a career in law enforcement.

paragraphs.text: Phil Plummer was born in Montgomery County, Ohio, lives in Dayton, and graduated from Chaminade Julienne High School.

He earned an associate degree in criminal justice from the University of Toledo and a B.S. in business management from the University of Phoenix, and completed executive training at the FBI National Academy.
His career in Montgomery County included service as a corrections officer, deputy sheriff, sergeant, major, chief deputy and sheriff.
Plummer's Ohio House tenure began in 2019, and in 2025–2026 his committee assignments are Finance, General Government, Judiciary, Public Safety, and Rules and Reference.
He advanced from the May 5, 2026 Republican primary for Senate District 5 and faces Democrat Jeffrey Harris in the general election, with no incumbent in the race.
